spec_match.rationale: Exercises the proposal's exact motivating case (terminal join on a helper pipeline vs Array.from round-trip and reduce concatenation) with the real Iterator.prototype.join when present; separator, empty-iterator and empty-string semantics match the Stage 3 draft and were cross-checked against V8 15.0 via deno --v8-flags=--js-iterator-join.

interactive.rationale: Textarea, separator input and run button drive a real map/filter helper pipeline; the output, per-workaround comparison panels, and code echo all update per run, including the reduce-throws-on-empty failure when the textarea is cleared.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises the canonical pipeline-ending use case with the three historical workarounds compared, which is exactly what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers empty pipeline (returns "" while reduce throws TypeError, demonstrated live), single-element, duplicate/blank inputs, and arbitrary separators; the deeper failure contract is deliberately delegated to the edge-cases-and-closing sibling.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5095183554314240 and the proposal motivation section directly.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite (11 assertions) checks the real contract this page relies on — default comma, empty-iterator empty string, coercion, consumption — with guarded negative checks that fail rather than vacuously pass on browsers without the method; all 11 verified passing on real V8 15.0.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Driven headlessly via CDP (page-driver join-pipeline run, Chromium 141, 2026-08-16): banner correctly reports banner-absent, pipeline dedupes case-insensitively (css/javascript duplicates dropped), empty input yields "" with reduce throwing TypeError, engine tag shows spec-model label; zero console errors, zero failed requests. Screenshots: scratchpad join-pipeline.png (desktop 1280), m-pipeline.png (mobile 360x740 DPR2 post-interaction), plus reports/responsive/v153/iterator-join/{desktop,mobile}.png.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts iterator-join-banner-honest (shared banner) and pipeline-join-matches-array-join after the primary action; a pipeline failure asserts pipeline-join-ran false with the error string, no noisy console paths.

design_system.rationale: All colours are CSS variables, engine tags use accent-emerald/amber with bg-ivory text on AA-contrast pairs, buttons override both background and color, focus-visible outlines everywhere.

accessibility.rationale: Every input has an explicit label, results are <output> elements (implicit polite live region) plus a role=status stats line, the availability banner is a labelled note, code samples are keyboard-scrollable via tabindex, and all controls are native elements in a logical focus order.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v153/iterator-join: desktop clean, mobile OK; true-mobile emulation (360x740, DPR2/3) shows scrollWidth 360 with no horizontal overflow, comparison cards stack via auto-fit minmax grid, buttons/inputs are 44px min-height; m-pipeline.png visually reviewed post-interaction.

openQuestions.title: Show an allocation/cost readout, not just prose, for the three endings
openQuestions.detail: The comparison panel states the cost difference (intermediate array vs intermediate strings vs streaming) in prose. A future pass could instrument the three endings with a counting wrapper iterator to display how many elements each strategy materialises before producing output — making the streaming claim measurable in-page rather than asserted.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls table layout narrow mobile viewport no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use flexbox for single-axis control rows, grid with auto-fit/minmax and intrinsic sizing for card comparisons; avoid fixed widths so narrow viewports reflow instead of overflowing.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls use a wrapping flex row; the three-workaround comparison is grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 300px), 1fr)); code blocks scroll within overflow-x:auto containers; verified scrollWidth 360 at mobile width.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce dynamic result updates screen reader live region output element
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native elements with implicit semantics; label every control; expose dynamic results through live regions and keep tables/landmarks semantic.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Results use <output> (implicit aria-live polite) plus a role=status summary; all fields have <label for>; buttons are native with focus-visible styling; the banner is a role=note with an aria-label.

summary: Canonical/basic angle for Iterator.prototype.join: a real helper pipeline ends in the real join (or a clearly labelled spec-model on pre-153 engines), with the three historical workarounds executed live for comparison, including reduce's empty-iterator TypeError. Verified headlessly on Chromium 141 (model path, honest absent banner) and against real V8 15.0 in Deno for the native path semantics.
